---
title: Preface
---

This book explains the probabilistic concepts behind modern deep learning, from maximum likelihood to diffusion models. The motivation, the common thread and a map of the book are presented in the introduction (@sec-introduction).

**Prerequisites.** The book assumes some familiarity with neural networks and gradient descent, and with basic probability and linear algebra. Derivations are given step by step; the longer proofs are hidden in collapsed boxes, which can be skipped on a first reading.

**Figures.** Most figures are generated by small Python scripts available in the repository of the book, and many of them are computed exactly on simple examples, without any training. Some figures are taken from other sources ("Source:" in the caption); their copyright stays with their respective authors.

This document is *work in progress*. Feel free to comment, correct or suggest by writing to <julien.vitay@gmail.com>.
